youtube.title: Napoleon escaped exile. The army sent to stop him joined him 👑 #shorts
youtube.caption:
Napoleon escaped exile on Elba… and the soldiers sent to shoot him switched sides on the spot. 👑

Shoot or join Napoleon? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: on 7 March 1815 at Laffrey, the 5th Line Infantry Regiment blocked Napoleon's road. He walked up alone, opened his coat and said "If there is any soldier among you who wishes to kill his Emperor, here I am." They shouted "Vive l'Empereur!" and joined him. Twelve days later King Louis XVIII fled Paris.
